report.answer_text:
David Szalay won the 2025 Booker Prize for his novel *Flesh*.
*Flesh* was named the winner at a ceremony in London on Monday, 10 November 2025.[1]
Szalay is the first Hungarian-British writer to win the Booker Prize.[2]
The prize is worth £50,000.[3]
He had been shortlisted once before, in 2016, for *All That Man Is*.[3]
The judging panel was chaired by Roddy Doyle, who won the prize in 1993.[2]
The International Booker Prize is a separate award. In 2025 it went to Banu Mushtaq and her translator Deepa Bhasthi for *Heart Lamp*.[4]
